admission.justification: The settings resolver, warmup exclusion and document-chat listing share one environment-derived identity, preventing a host restart from silently starting an explainer turn or a listing from inventing its role receipt.

applicability: Settings review-presenter role resolution, explainer warmup exclusion and selected leaf document chats. Discovery/listing does not start or resume the explainer; showing or writing its own chat owns lazy resume.
conditions: The normal review-presenter settings role and host catalog resolve launch choices.
An existing explainer environment supplies the derived seat identity.
Chat listing requires reachable, found and unarchived host state.
exclusions: Host restart warmup resuming an explainer.
A settings change, another model catalog, or absent AR_PLAYWRIGHT being replaced by a guessed value.

evidence: scratch/curator/b5e6f7a8-9c01-4d23-8e45-f6a7b8c9d012/helpers/backend/post-L194-source-equivalence.json; semantic-recommendations.json; MIK-R105@v4; MIK-R106@v2 rule1; MIK-R186@v2 rule5

statement: The explainer uses the normal settings role resolver for harness/model/effort/mode/features and creates its own seat without a turn; host-start warmup excludes environment-derived explainer ids, and the selected leaf lists its reachable unarchived explainer chat separately from role receipts even after a live role ends the receipt scan.
